  "extract_plan": {
    "chunk_summary": "Conclusion of the SFV paper: restates State Fidelity Validity as a validity construct for stateful AI-assisted pipelines, its five-threat taxonomy (Semantic Drift, False State Injection, Compression Distortion, State Supersession Failure, State Discontinuity), its operationalization (indicators, severity scale, reproducibility checklist) and crosswalk to classical validity, production incident evidence, countermeasures, open questions, and the gap it fills relative to adjacent literature."
  },

    {
      "id": "c-sfv",
      "name": "State Fidelity Validity",
      "aliases": ["SFV"],
      "description": "A formal validity construct that names, decomposes, and operationalizes the instrument stability assumption for stateful AI-assisted pipelines.",
      "anchor": "introduced State Fidelity Validity",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0020"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-instrument-stability",
      "name": "instrument stability",
      "aliases": ["instrument stability assumption"],
      "description": "The assumption, presupposed by classical validity frameworks, that the measuring instrument does not change during measurement.",
      "anchor": "assume instrument stability",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0020"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-context-window",
      "name": "context window",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "The mutable part of the composite instrument, rewritten by use as decisions, terminology, parameters, and findings accumulate and are shed.",
      "anchor": "the context window that completes",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0020"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-stateful-pipelines",
      "name": "stateful AI-assisted pipelines",

      "anchor": "for stateful AI-assisted pipelines",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0020"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-threat-taxonomy",
      "name": "threat taxonomy",

      "description": "Taxonomy distinguishing five structurally distinct modes of state degradation, each mapping to a classical validity type it degrades.",
      "anchor": "threat taxonomy",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0020"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-semantic-drift",
      "name": "Semantic Drift",
      "aliases": ["T1"],
      "description": "State degradation occurring wherever terminology is established and then reused across turns or sessions.",
      "anchor": "Semantic Drift occurs",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0020"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-false-state-injection",
      "name": "False State Injection",
      "aliases": ["T2"],
      "description": "State degradation occurring wherever an LLM can confabulate its own operational history.",
      "anchor": "False State Injection occurs",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0020"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-compression-distortion",
      "name": "Compression Distortion",
      "aliases": ["T3"],
      "description": "State degradation occurring wherever automated summarization discards the reasoning behind recorded choices.",
      "anchor": "Compression Distortion occurs",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0020"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-state-supersession-failure",
      "name": "State Supersession Failure",
      "aliases": ["T4"],
      "description": "State degradation occurring wherever revised parameters can silently revert.",
      "anchor": "State Supersession Failure occurs",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0020"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-state-discontinuity",
      "name": "State Discontinuity",
      "aliases": ["T5"],
      "description": "State degradation occurring wherever session boundaries interrupt accumulated state.",
      "anchor": "State Discontinuity occurs",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0020"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-severity-scale",
      "name": "four-level severity scale",
      "aliases": [],

      "anchor": "four-level severity scale",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0020"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-repro-checklist",
      "name": "reproducibility checklist",

      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0020"

    {
      "id": "c-construct-validity",
      "name": "construct validity",
